Cohort 1: GBM, N = up to 25 patients

candidate_evidence.quote: Subjects will be given oral dosing of ABM-1310 twice daily (BID) for 28-day cycles of continuous administration until progressive disease (PD), unacceptable toxicity, or other withdrawal criteria are met as clinically observed.
